title: Waves, interference and boundaries
summary: Field-guide chapter 2: the linear N-mass chain (the alpha = 0 FPUT case). Standing waves, two counter-propagating pulses, and reflection off a fixed versus a free end, validated case by case against an independent Python reference.

sources: French, Vibrations and Waves, MIT Introductory Physics Series, 1971, ch. 6-7
Crawford, Waves, Berkeley Physics Course vol. 3, 1968, ch. 2-4
Hairer, Lubich & Wanner, Geometric Numerical Integration, 2nd ed., Springer 2006, ch. I
